'''''Star Wars Adventures 13: The Final Battle''''' was the thirteenth installment of [[Scholastic]]'s [[Star Wars Adventures (Scholastic)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series. This book is a reprint of ''[[Episode I Adventures 15: The Final Battle]]''. It consisted of a young reader novel and an accompanying game book for use with the story, and was sent out with [[Star Wars Adventures Magazine 13|''Star Wars Adventures Magazine'' 13]] in [[October]] [[2003]].
